*AI-written, from the entries (PLAN §13). The 297 premises that only family A's laws take, or only its exits drop. The seeds and the premises taken across families are on [the premise ledger](../PREMISES.md), which also says how the lists are read. A premise is no result and the ledger proves nothing; whether one holds of an actual system is never established here.*
